init_tensor_trunc_normal: init a PyTorch tensor with truncated normal distribution values using trunc_normal_
calculate_conv_padding: calculate symmetric padding for a convolution layer using get_padding
apply_same_padding: apply TensorFlow-style SAME padding to a PyTorch tensor using pad_same
apply_drop_path: apply stochastic depth drop path regularization to a tensor using drop_path
use_droppath_module: use the DropPath nn.Module for stochastic depth in a residual block
